correctness.rationale: For even \(m\ge2\), induction gives \(F(m)\le2\phi(m)-1\). If \(3^kp\) is perfect totient and \(p-1=2^a3^bu\) with \((u,6)=1\), then \(F(\phi(3^kp))=3^{k-1}(p+2)\) and \(\phi(\phi(3^kp))=2\cdot3^{k-2}(p-1)\phi(u)/u\). Substitution yields \(\phi(u)/u>3(p+2)/(4(p-1))>3/4\); the support exclusions follow from the Euler product. The finite checker is corroborative only.
residual_risks: Necessary only; existence for \(k\ge4\) remains open.
